address: 164/13-15 Soi Chaeng Watthana-Pak Kret 33, Chaeng Watthana Road, Bang Phut, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi, 11120, Thailand
bio: This family-run establishment is renowned for its traditional recipes, serving fresh meat and seafood flavours in simple yet refined and lightly seasoned dishes. Catering to different tastes, the stir-fried liver with garlic is made with either pork or chicken liver. The inviting, comfortable space can also accommodate larger groups....
